tasks.name: Setup Project Structure
tasks.description: Initialize the project with necessary folders and files for a blog website.

tasks.name: Design Homepage Layout
tasks.description: Create the layout for the homepage where blog posts will be displayed.

tasks.name: Implement Post Creation Form
tasks.description: Develop a form for users to create new blog posts with title, content, and publish date.

tasks.name: Develop Backend for Post Creation
tasks.description: Create backend logic to handle post creation and store data in the database.

tasks.name: Setup Database
tasks.description: Configure the database to store blog post data including title, content, and publish date.

tasks.name: Implement Post Display Logic
tasks.description: Develop logic to retrieve and display blog posts on the homepage.

tasks.name: Create Post Display UI
tasks.description: Design and implement the user interface for displaying blog posts on the homepage.

tasks.name: Test Post Creation
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure that post creation functionality works correctly.

tasks.name: Test Post Display
tasks.description: Perform testing to ensure that posts are displayed correctly on the homepage.

tasks.name: Deploy Website
tasks.description: Deploy the blog website to a hosting platform.

T1.implementation_approach: Create a directory structure with folders for source code, tests, assets, and configuration files. Initialize version control.
T1.notes: Consider using a project scaffolding tool if available.

T2.implementation_approach: Use wireframing tools to design the layout. Implement using HTML/CSS with a responsive framework.
T2.notes: Ensure the design is responsive and accessible.

T3.implementation_approach: Create a form using HTML. Use JavaScript for client-side validation and AJAX for submission.
T3.notes: Ensure form validation is robust and user-friendly.

T4.implementation_approach: Develop REST API endpoints to handle post creation. Use a web framework to manage requests.
T4.notes: Ensure proper authentication and validation on the server side.

T5.implementation_approach: Choose a database system and define schema for posts. Set up connections and migrations.
T5.notes: Consider using ORM for easier database management.

T6.implementation_approach: Implement logic to fetch posts from the database and format them for display.

T7.implementation_approach: Use a front-end framework to create components for displaying posts.
T7.notes: Ensure the UI is dynamic and updates with new data.

T8.implementation_approach: Write unit and integration tests for post creation using a testing framework.
T8.notes: Focus on edge cases and error handling.

T9.implementation_approach: Write tests to ensure posts are displayed correctly and UI updates as expected.
T9.notes: Include tests for different screen sizes and browsers.

T10.implementation_approach: Set up a CI/CD pipeline to automate deployment. Use a cloud service for hosting.
T10.notes: Ensure environment variables and secrets are managed securely.
